promptContext: You are translating the documentation website for Champollion, an open-source CLI tool (npm package) that translates locale files and content for websites. Developer-facing technical documentation — professional tone, no marketing fluff. Preserve ALL markdown/MDX formatting, links, admonitions, code blocks, CLI commands, config keys, package names, and URLs exactly as-is. Keep proper nouns in English (Champollion, Docusaurus, OpenRouter, DeepL). The project was born from translating a production website into Plains Cree; treat references to Indigenous languages with cultural respect.
